rpc user.v1.UserService.CreateUser (user.v1.CreateUserRequest) returns (user.v1.CreateUserResponse)

message user.v1.CreateUserRequest {
  string name = 1;
  optional string nickname = 2;
  optional int32 age = 3;
  user.v1.UserStatus status = 4;  // USER_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED | USER_STATUS_ACTIVE | USER_STATUS_DISABLED
  repeated string tags = 5;
  user.v1.Profile profile = 6;
  map<string, string> labels = 7;
  optional bool admin = 10;
  repeated user.v1.Address addresses = 11;
  map<int32, string> scores = 12;
  map<string, user.v1.Address> places = 13;
  repeated user.v1.UserStatus history = 14;  // USER_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED | USER_STATUS_ACTIVE | USER_STATUS_DISABLED
  oneof contact {
    string email = 8;
    string phone = 9;
  }
}

message user.v1.CreateUserResponse {
  user.v1.User user = 1;
}
